corpus._comment: Workspace-graph bench corpus — open-source, four language clusters, every lib pin taken from what its consumer actually declares (prometheus go.mod -> client_golang v1.20.5; drupal 11.1/laravel 11 -> symfony 7.2; flask 3.1.0 -> werkzeug 3.1.x; nest is a single-checkout monorepo, the D1 degenerate case). Consumers are the existing bench/repos.json pins. Workspace root is a dedicated directory reaching members by relative path (design D1 sanctioned shape).

header.bars: bench/workspace/README.md (registered 2026-08-17; the gate script reads bars from there, never from its own source)
header.gt_discipline: import-mediated plain-text extraction across member checkouts; cross-member scoped; arm-neutral
header.rung2_note: no organic bare-name cross-edges in this OSS corpus
header.xchain_note: xchain is nest-only: a recorded corpus fact, not a gap. The php, py and go clusters are two members deep (lib + consumer), so no A->B->C chain exists in them; no chain was synthesised and no member was added.

xalias.reason: change 0018 (aliased-import resolution) has not landed, so the index cannot answer alias tasks; excluded from the scored structural subset at freeze per bar B5, not after mining. Mined, counted and reported separately.

subsets.arithmetic: structural excluding xalias = xchain 22 + xcollide 20 + xsubtypes 68 = 110 (>= 105); control = xcallers 24 + ximpact 24 + xnew 10 = 58 (>= 40); total = 203 (>= 145)
subsets.note: control shapes are greppable (the bare name is the answer key); structural shapes are not. grade_ws.py reads this map from the header so a shape added or excluded here cannot leave the reported subsets stale.
